Our Story

A craft rooted in Multan, carried forward one pair at a time.

Bhutta Khussa Mehal began in the lanes of Saddar, Multan Cantt, where leatherwork and hand embroidery have been passed from one generation of artisans to the next. What started as a small family workshop has grown into a name trusted by customers across the region for khussa that is built to last and finished with care.

Every pair that leaves our workshop is cut, stitched, and embroidered by hand. We work with genuine leather and traditional zari and tilla threadwork, keeping the techniques that make khussa distinct from mass-produced footwear.

Today, we bring that same craftsmanship online — so whether you're shopping for daily wear, a festive occasion, or your wedding day, you can find a pair made the way it always has been: by hand, with intention.

Where We're Based

5CPQ+V97, Saddar Multan Cantt Commercial Area, Multan, Pakistan
